subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: After final-head behavior proof is attached, should the owner approve this multi-channel lifecycle consolidation and its additive resolver-only config contract for merge?
rationale: The branch deliberately centralizes compatibility-sensitive message, session, and delivery behavior across many bundled channels; this is an owner acceptance decision rather than a mechanical repair choice.

options.title: Approve after final-head proof
options.body: Accept the refactor once a redacted run at the current head demonstrates Telegram delivery and the owner confirms the shared lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Hold for narrower evidence
options.body: Keep the branch open until final-head proof also covers any channel-specific invariant the owner considers higher risk than the existing focused suites.

recommendation.title: Approve after final-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the refactor once a redacted run at the current head demonstrates Telegram delivery and the owner confirms the shared lifecycle boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and this follow-up place the lifecycle ownership design and final compatibility choices with this feature's recent contributor.
